fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-01-02, a transport worker was allegedly waylaid near Sindhu Puram Industrial Area and cash of about Rs. 50,000 was taken from the complainant. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-01-02 at roughly 00:05. The online submission was made by Lavanya Ammal (9000000175). The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly forced to stop on a lonely stretch before valuables were taken.
fields.Keywords: highway robbery, roadside, photograph, industrial area, CCTV, night
